description: Return the current Codex OAuth access token (null when signed out) to judge-openai only; any other caller gets provider/forbidden. Pass rejected_token after an HTTP 401 to force one refresh of a ChatGPT sign-in session. Never returns the refresh or id token.

rejected_token.description: The access token an upstream call just rejected with HTTP 401. When it is still the current ChatGPT sign-in token, the session is refreshed once. Ignored for vault and Codex CLI credentials.

access_token.description: The OAuth access token for `Authorization: Bearer`; null when signed out.
